# Correct the setup preview command
originator: kouko
kind: engineering
needs-design: no — Correct documentation to match the existing README command; no interface or tool behavior changes.
status: open

## Problem
Design contributors cannot start the page preview by following the setup guide.

## Proposed outcome
The setup guide documents the current preview command consistently with README.md.

## Acceptance
1. SETUP.md documents `elm serve --port 4100` in the existing preview instruction.
2. The port number and all other SETUP.md text remain unchanged; tool behavior remains unchanged.

## Constraints
- Replace only `--listen` with `--port` on the existing SETUP.md command line.
- Stop at intent confirmation; do not implement or publish before the user's response.
- Do not send messages or run an external coding agent.

## Out of scope
- Changes to tool behavior or other project documentation.

## Open questions
- none
